- debrid/europe-pmc $.reliability_note: The capture proves the HTTPS OA tree and the .xml.gz files dated 2026-11-21, but it has no rate or throttling measurement. 'No throttling signal was seen at the low rate used here' is not supported by this capture.

- debrid/europe-pmc $.notes: Same as c09: the listing proves the HTTPS OA tree and the 2026-11-21 files, but it says nothing about the API or 'Metadata is effectively unlimited through each paged response'.
